ashby:abacum:abe13b44-f70c-4428-877c-bb0.summary:
Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance . By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities . Headquartered in New York , we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex , and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners , with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator , Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

sections.title: About Abacum
paras: Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Partners are one of Abacum's fastest-growing areas of growth and we're investing to make them even more strategic.

As a Senior Partner Account Manager, you'll own a portfolio of our most strategic technology and advisory partners in North America. That includes the ERPs, accounting platforms, and finance-stack companies whose customers are Abacum's best-fit buyers as well as key advisory firms who help customers transform their finance operations. You'll turn our partner relationships into repeatable, measurable pipeline and successful joint customers.
This is a senior individual contributor role on the Partnerships team, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and our Partner Solutions team.

sections.title: What you will do
bullets: Own a portfolio of technology and advisory partners across North America, from recruitment and contracting through activation, GTM execution, growth, and executive-level relationship management.

Build and maintain joint business plans with each partner. Each plan will cover the shared ICP, target accounts, pipeline, ARR, and services goals, and an operating cadence to hold both sides accountable.

Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by co-selling with our AEs through joint account mapping, target-account planning, shared pipeline reviews, and multithreaded relationships on both sides.

Drive the enablement of partner sales and technical teams on Abacum's value, positioning, and core use cases, in collaboration with Partner Solutions, so their teams can confidently identify, refer, and support opportunities.
Enable Abacum's AEs to sell with partners: when to engage them, how to run a co-sell motion, and how to jointly manage sales cycles and build field relationships for mutual benefit.
Partner with Marketing on joint go-to-market programs such as webinars, events, co-branded content, integration marketing, and targeted campaigns with partners.
Help shape how Partner Operations and the Abacum Partner Program scales, including tiering, incentives, playbooks, reporting, and the processes that make partner-led growth repeatable.
Work with Product and Partner Solutions on integration roadmaps and joint value propositions and bring partner and market feedback back into the business.

sections.title: What You Bring
bullets: 8+ years in partner management, channel sales, alliances, or business development at a B2B SaaS company managing systems integrators, advisory firms, or consulting partners, including 4+ years in a pipeline- or revenue-accountable partner role.

A track record of turning technology and advisory partnerships into sourced pipeline and closed revenue, not just integrations, logos, and press releases. Partnerships with ERP, accounting, HRIS, or other Office of the CFO platforms as well as FP&A advisory and system integrators are ideal.
Experience in the CPM, EPM, or FP&A software space, or selling to finance leaders, is strongly preferred. Strong EPM sales experience without partner experience will also be considered.
Proven success co-selling alongside AEs on complex, multi-stakeholder mid-market and enterprise deals.
Confidence building and presenting joint business plans to partner executives and holding partners accountable to their commitments.
Excellent relationship-building, communication, and negotiation skills, and you're comfortable in the room with partner leadership and CFOs.
An analytical, operationally rigorous approach. You're fluent in Salesforce, partner attribution, and pipeline metrics. Experience with PRM tools is a plus.\
Based in the US and able to travel for partner meetings, prospect meetings, and industry events.

ashby:anrok:e401db5e-0208-42e3-82ce-02d9.summary:
Anrok is the leading tax automation platform enabling businesses to expand globally without compliance complexity.

As the digital economy has grown 6x over the last decade, software businesses have gone from not worrying about sales tax to needing to monitor exposure, calculate rates, and file returns across 50+ US jurisdictions and many countries worldwide. This creates a critical bottleneck for companies that should be able to transact with customers everywhere.

Anrok eliminates this complexity by connecting with billing and payment systems to automate tax monitoring, calculations, and filing end-to-end. Our unified platform handles the ever-changing maze of tax laws at municipal, state, and federal levels—so companies can focus on growth, not compliance.

sections.title: In this role, you will
bullets: Manage an onboarding book of business of accounts through their onboarding journey, coordinating with Anrok's Tax and Solutions Engineering teams to resolve tax and technical issues and questions, and configure platform settings for each customer's business needs, ensuring each account is set up correctly.

Execute customer education and training, becoming a product expert who can guide customers through Anrok's platform features, ensuring customers are set up for success by skillfully leveraging the platform to its full potential.

Develop and maintain organized project tracking systems and operational processes that support efficient customer onboarding, leveraging and creating standardized workflows and documentation to ensure consistent service delivery.
Track and monitor customer progress throughout onboarding, using data insights to identify potential issues early and ensure customers are successfully adopting platform features.
Regularly update internal teams on client asks and issues
Keep consistent and precise records in Anrok’s CRM, regularly updating onboarding status, blockers, account persona details, and key account information.
Coordinate smooth handoffs to account management teams by maintaining detailed customer records and comprehensive transition documentation.

Continuously improve onboarding processes by analyzing customer feedback, completion timelines, and success metrics, and implementing operational enhancements that increase efficiency and customer satisfaction.

sections.title: What excites us
bullets: You have 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or project coordination roles, ideally at a tech company working with SMB to mid-market customers

You’re curious and motivated to learn new tools — you've experimented with AI in your work or on your own, you're excited about what's possible, and you've built something with it (an application, a workflow, a creative solution to a real problem) that you can walk us through.
You have excellent organizational and project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple customer accounts and complex onboarding timelines simultaneously
You thrive in process creation and systematization, with a bias for action and the ability to implement solutions quickly and effectively
You have strong relationship-building skills and can develop rapport with customers across various business sizes and industries
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with meticulous attention to detail and organizational systems
You are proactive in identifying issues and taking initiative to resolve customer challenges and improve internal processes

ashby:applied:d69688f3-5da4-47fd-85f0-3b.summary: Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co .

sections.title: About the role
paras: You’ll grow a portfolio of our most important automotive OEM and supplier accounts in North America, working hand in hand with our Senior Business Development leaders. Our deals are large, technical and multi-year, and they don’t come from one relationship. They come from understanding what an engineering team needs, what a program manager is worried about, what purchasing will push back on, and what the CTO is trying to achieve, then turning all of that into a deal that works. That’s your job. You’ll work every layer of the customer, from individual engineers to the C-suite, and pull what you learn into a clear picture of each account. Senior BD will use that picture to shape and close deals with you. Internally, you’ll coordinate engineering, product, legal and finance to deliver on what we commit.

sections.title: At Applied Intuition, you will:
bullets: Partner with Senior Business Development on account strategy and deal execution, from first opportunity to signed agreement
Build and maintain relationships across every level of the customer: ICs, engineering managers, program leads, purchasing and executives
Gather input from all of those stakeholders and turn it into clear deal strategy, including who matters, what they need, where the risks are and how to win
Spot and develop expansion opportunities across our product portfolio
Coordinate internal teams to deliver on customer commitments and fix issues quickly
Prepare and support executive engagements, and keep forecasts accurate

sections.title: We're looking for someone who has:
paras: Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
bullets: 3–5+ years of quota-carrying sales or account management experience. We welcome more experienced candidates and will level them accordingly.
An outstanding ability to coordinate across many layers of a large organization at once, and to know which conversation matters at which moment
Strong judgment in turning scattered, sometimes conflicting stakeholder input into a clear view that drives a deal forward
A track record of selling complex technical products in enterprise environments, ideally automotive, robotics or deep tech
Experience working closely with senior sellers or executives on large, multi-stakeholder deals
Clear, confident communication with engineers and executives alike
Consistent attainment against targets
A bachelor’s degree

ashby:arch-solutions:01a53d0f-a4dd-4bd3-.summary:
Arch Solutions keeps critical infrastructure equipment running for organizations whose clients and patients depend on it.

We work across two areas of expertise. On the network side, our engineers troubleshoot and repair network, server, and storage infrastructure for large enterprises, keeping them connected to their data and systems. Through our Arch Medical team, we repair and maintain imaging equipment, including MRI machines, CT scanners, X-ray rooms, and more. We support rural and underserved communities across our region.

Founded in 2010 and grown without outside investment, Arch is headquartered in Edmond, Oklahoma and operates globally. We’ve built our reputation on responding fast and getting it right the first time, in situations where the stakes are high. That’s the standard behind everything we do, and everyone who works here is part of upholding it.

sections.title: Role and Responsibilities:
paras: The Executive Account Manager is responsible for acquiring new hospital and clinic customers by building trusted relationships, understanding customer priorities, and positioning Arch’s TPM services as a reliable, value-driven alternative for imaging equipment support. This role focuses on developing and advancing qualified opportunities, guiding complex buying groups through the sales process, and closing deals that meet revenue, margin, and operational standards.

Success in this role requires strong discovery, disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and consistent use of CRM tools, while operating in a highly regulated, risk-sensitive healthcare environment. The Executive Account Manager partners closely with internal teams to ensure deals are well-qualified, executable, and aligned with customer needs. Focus should be on:
• Relationships: Build and deepen trusted relationships with hospital and clinic stakeholders by helping optimize imaging equipment uptime, reliability, and service outcomes.
bullets: Win Rate: Improvement in close rates on qualified opportunities through effective discovery, positioning, and deal execution.
Deal Quality: Close deals that meet pricing, margin, and operational readiness standards with minimal post-close rework or escalation.

Strategic Client Engagement: Increased depth and quality of client engagement (trainings, executive alignment, and structured sales meetings) that directly supports opportunity progression and deal conversion

sections.title: What measurable success looks like (KPI’s):
paras: At Arch, we measure what matters. Success in business (and life!) relies upon goal setting and corresponding hard & soft metrics. Hard metrics consist of empirical and quantifiable data that can accurately show progress towards a goal or objective, while soft metrics are subjective and express a more intangible sentiment about an individual and/or organization's integrity and spirit. Success in this role marries hard and soft metrics to provide a 360-degree view of the progress towards and achievement of SMART goals. Goals and metrics will be co-created by you and management to ensure alignment and agreement.
bullets: Pipeline Coverage: Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of 3–4× assigned quota to support predictable revenue attainment.
Forecast Accuracy ≤10% variance by quarter, calculated by (forecasted revenue – actual closed revenue) ÷ (actual closed revenue)
CRM Discipline: Update all deal advances within 24 hours to ensure accurate opportunity data (stage, value, close date, next steps)
ACV/TCV Target: Meet or exceed 100% of quarterly quota and yearly ACV and TCV targets

sections.title: INTEGRITY: WE ARE OUR WORD
paras: Arch subscribes to Michael Jensen’s interpretation of Integrity. At its foundation, we do what we say we will do, at the time we said we would do it. If ever that is not the case, we participate fully in resolving the impact for all affected parties.

sections.title: WE ARE CAUSE IN THE MATTER
paras: Arch believes that no matter the circumstance or situation, we have the ability to impact and influence it toward a mutually successful outcome. We are not resigned to how a circumstance might appear; we are committed to producing performance and see ourselves as able to do so.

ashby:auror:8cf0d797-3a53-4663-bdea-4b7a.summary:
At Auror, we’re empowering the retail industry to tackle theft and Organised Retail Crime, a $150 Billion problem globally. It’s high volume crime that’s increasingly organised in nature and is putting people, retailers, and communities at risk every day.

Founded in New Zealand 12 years ago, we’re working with some of the best and largest retailers in the world across the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and the UK. Auror is connecting people and intelligence to reduce crime. We’re using technology for good.

Our mission is clear: reduce violent retail crime by 50% in 5 years. It's an ambitious goal - and one we believe is achievable. In partnership with our leading retail partners, we need people with the passion, determination, and innovation required to overcome one of the world's largest problems. If you’re looking to make a difference with and for the people dedicated to…

sections.title: About Auror
paras: We're also embracing the potential of AI to supercharge our impact - whether that's enhancing the way we detect trends, support our customers, or improve internal workflows. As a company, we're committed to responsibly incorporating AI into how we work and what we build, and we encourage all Aurors to be curious about how AI can elevate their work, regardless of role or function.

sections.title: The Role
paras: As Auror expands its recognition technology product portfolio — including License Plate Recognition (LPR) and Auror Subject Recognition (ASR) — and the range of hardware these integrate with, we're looking for a Pre-Sales Engineer who thrives at the sharp end of a customer conversation: someone who can hear "we're not sure this will work for us," stay composed, and think on their feet to showcase these new product capabilities to existing & new customers.

This is a customer-facing technical role spanning pre-sales engineering, proof-of-concept design, and ongoing technical advisory as customers expand or evolve their deployments. You'll understand what customers are trying to solve and translate that into the technical fit, the confidence to buy, and a clear path to deployment — partnering with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation teams throughout, and staying engaged as the technical escalation point as new deployments ramp up. You're equally comfortable holding your ground with a sceptical IT manager as you are running a live product demo for a retail operations team — and you don't rattle when a customer pushes back.

Auror provides the software layer for these technologies, but requires the customer to have/procure the correct hardware (cameras, servers etc) for our recognition technology solutions to work effectively. Therefore, this role needs to be able to explain the end-to-end solution, what hardware is required for their environment, and how to effectively implement it.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets:
Pre-Sales Engineering:

• Join sales calls as the technical subject matter expert for LPR and ASR — handling product deep-dives, capability questions, and technical objections with confidence.
Run technical discovery sessions to understand customer environments, existing infrastructure, and integration requirements.
Scope solutions accurately, identifying risks or constraints early so Sales teams can set the right expectations.
Produce technical documentation and implementation plans to support proposals — including integration guides, third-party hardware compatibility requirements, and site assessment summaries.
Deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of Auror's Core product and LPR / ASR solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

Proof-of-Concept Design:

• Design proof-of-concept scope and success criteria — right hardware, network conditions, and use case alignment — in partnership with the Technical Project Management team, who own implementation.
Track and report on PoC outcomes against the goals you set, synthesising findings for Sales and internal stakeholders — and feeding learnings back into how future PoCs and pitches are shaped.

Customer Technical Advisory:

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor to prospects and existing customers — fielding questions about system architecture, data handling, privacy, and integration pathways.

sections.title: Requirements
paras: We are looking for people who demonstrate a strong alignment to our Guiding Principles (you can find these on our Careers page ).

With diversity and inclusion at the forefront of Auror’s guiding principles, we promote a culture that celebrates diversity and inclusiveness at Auror, regardless of, but not limited to, race, gender, sexual orientation, family status, religion, ethnicity, national origin, physical disability, veteran status, or age.
bullets: You're comfortable discussing IT infrastructure at a high level and assessing how our technology fits into a customer's existing environment — flagging practical requirements like Linux fundamentals or mobile device compatibility that affect deployment.
You bring a structured approach to problem-solving — you gather information methodically, identify root causes, and don't jump to solutions before you've understood the problem.
You're comfortable with ambiguity and able to prioritise across multiple concurrent customers and opportunities.
You take privacy and ethical use of technology seriously, and you're confident discussing data handling, retention policies, and responsible AI with customers who ask hard questions.
You're a self-starter who improves the systems around you — if you notice a gap in documentation or a repeated question that should have a better answer, you fix it.

You have (or can quickly build) a working understanding of retail case management software and how Auror drives value through risk detection, so you can speak to the software experience, not just the hardware behind it.

ashby:beam-up:7cde46fc-9c14-4743-84bc-eb.summary:
At Beam, we’re building AI that serves society.

We're a global team of ambitious, hardworking problem solvers, applying fast-moving startup energy to work that makes the world a better place. If you want to apply your talent to the biggest problems society faces, Beam is the place for you.

You’ll be part of a high-performance culture where you'll make a huge impact, rapidly progress your career, and truly enjoy your work.

Over 120,000 frontline workers across 400+ customers already use Beam to take notes, provide live interpretation and handle phone calls, so they can focus on the people who need them most. This is just the beginning.

sections.title: About the role:
paras: As one of Beam's first Senior Account Managers in the US, you'll look after some of our biggest and most complex customers and help them get far more out of our products. You'll work closely with senior leadership while the team is still small enough that your results shape how we grow across the US.

Our US customers are counties and states, and you'll be their go-to partner. You'll find growth where it isn't obvious, step in when an account needs a hand, and build the kind of relationships that make leaders want to work with us again. You'll also help set the standard for the team around you. Every account you grow puts Beam in front of more frontline workers, and gives them more time for the people who need them.
This role is fully remote, and candidates must currently live in Mountain or Pacific Time Zone. Please submit one application for the Account Manager opening that matches your current time zone.

sections.title: You'll Be:
bullets: Owning Our Largest Accounts: Managing a portfolio that includes some of our biggest and most complex customers, where individual deals can run well beyond $200k.
Proving and demonstrating ROI: Making sure Beam’s tools deliver the impact our partners need, and presenting that value back to their leadership
Creating Growth Where It Isn't Obvious: Turning customer insight into multi-team, multi-product partnerships across new service areas, then building the case and the proposal.
Building Senior Networks: Working with economic buyers, division directors and IT leaders across complex customers and turning them into champions who join us at conferences and on webinars.
Leading Rescue on At-Risk Accounts: Spotting risk early and stepping in to protect and rebuild accounts that are going off track.

Running the Commercial Process: Owning contracting, procurement and legal from start to finish, with support from our bids team when an RFP comes up, and protecting deal value through creative management of the customer.
Making Calls Without a Playbook: Balancing customer, commercial and product trade-offs, and forecasting accurately and independently.
Navigating Public Funding: Understanding how state and county budgets work so you can position Beam well within them.

sections.title: You Have:
bullets: A Record of Growing Complex Accounts: 5+ years in account management or full-cycle sales, with proven success expanding large, high-stakes customer relationships and closing big deals, ideally in B2B SaaS and with a book of a similar size.
Senior-Level Presence: Experience building relationships across complex customers, and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders because you've earned their trust.
Commercial Judgement: You make strong calls without a playbook and protect value through insight and creativity.
Energy and Sharpness: You're curious and quick, and you ask real questions that come out of the conversation, not just ones you'd planned to run through.
A Habit of Experimenting: You test ideas, learn from what lands, and continuously iterate upon them.
Complex Deal Experience: Comfort with long buying journeys involving procurement, legal and several decision-makers.
Startup Pace: The drive to work at speed in an early-stage team, where you'll help define the role as you go.
Public Sector Curiosity (Nice to Have): Experience in government, public sector or social care is helpful but not essential. We'll teach you the rest.

sections.title: Success looks like:
bullets: Your largest accounts converting, renewing and growing ARR quarter-on-quarter
Growth in places it wasn't obvious, through new service areas and multi-product partnerships
At-risk accounts recovered, with risks flagged early rather than surfacing late
A forecast the business can rely on
Senior champions in each account who advocate for Beam and work with us as partners
Beam's reputation and visibility growing in your states
Colleagues learning from your approach, with your impact reaching beyond your own book
Contracts, procurement and legal handled smoothly and on time

ashby:buspatrol:e8729442-e28e-4715-9896-.summary: At BusPatrol, we’re on a mission to make school transportation safer for children and communities. As a leader in AI-powered safety solutions, we bring cutting-edge technology—AI, machine learning, and IoT—to school buses across North America. We’re the most trusted stop-arm safety program globally, delivering transparency and safety at scale. In short, this is purpose-driven work that measurably changes behavior in the communities we serve.

sections.title: The Opportunity:
paras: If you’re a product leader who is energized by hard human-in-the-loop problems, including capturing data and turning that into high trust evidence packages that lead to defensible decisions—this is your role. BusPatrol is investing in the experience that sits at the heart of our business: serving Law Enforcement Officers (LEOs), making their lives easier, optimizing the Court partnership, and delivering measurable safety outcomes.

We are North America’s leader in automated school bus, student, and community safety solutions protecting more than nearly half a million students across 25 states. We are growing and expanding our footprint into exciting new use cases. This role will be central to building our newest use case.

As Principal Product Manager, Law Enforcement Experience, you will own one of BusPatrol’s most mission-critical challenges end-to-end. This is fundamentally a high-volume, high-stakes decision-UX challenge at the center of our enforcement platform.
bullets: Defining a high-trust experience for law enforcement officers that turns raw captured events into fast, confident, and defensible decisions
Define standard work for a high-confidence evidence package
Identifying where automation can remove friction and improve throughput in partnership with the AI/Automation team
Preserving the human in the loop, where judgment, accountability, and trust matter most
Establish the metrics, instrumentation, and feedback loops that make review quality, speed, and consistency measurable while continuously improving

sections.title: Own the Review & Approval Experience
bullets: Set and drive the end-to-end vision for how captured evidence is assembled, presented, reviewed, and approved.
Map the full reviewer/approver journey, find the friction, and relentlessly remove the steps, clicks, and ambiguity that slow people down or erode trust.
Treat the human decision as the product. Every design choice should make the right call easier and the wrong call harder.

sections.title: Define the Evidence Package
bullets: Decide what a reviewable package must contain to support a confident, defensible decision—and what is noise.
Deeply listen to our LEO partners and Legal team to understand their unique needs and partner preferences
Ensure packages arrive complete, well-ordered, and self-explanatory, so reviewers spend their attention deciding, not hunting for context.

sections.title: Design for Speed and Confidence
bullets: Reduce cognitive load at every turn: clear hierarchy, sensible defaults, and an interface that guides reviewers toward accurate decisions.
Build for high volume without sacrificing care—the experience must scale up to 100,000 reviews per day while keeping each decision trustworthy.
Design for the hard stuff: edge cases, ambiguity, and the moments where a reviewer needs to slow down and look closer all while preserving compliance.

ashby:cheiron:a8514f9b-17d9-40a0-8674-a0.summary:
Cheiron raised an $11 million seed round led by Menlo Ventures , bringing total funding to $16 million to date, with the backing and strategic support of industry veterans including Moderna co-founder and MIT Institute Professor Robert Langer, former Pfizer Chief Medical Officer Freda Lewis-Hall, Chai Discovery co-founder and CEO Josh Meier, former Starbucks CEO Laxman Narasimhan, and former Apple AI chief John Giannandrea.

Cheiron is building the first AI-native operating system designed to represent an entire drug program as a single connected system. The company’s platform helps biopharma teams represent, reason over, and stress-test the full state of a drug development program, including the claims, evidence, assumptions, risks, decisions, and commitments that determine whether a therapy advances. In less than six months since launch, Cheiron has been adopted by tens of thousands…

sections.title: ■ Company Overview
paras: Cheiron is expanding into pharmaceutical CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) teams. CMC governs how a drug is made, tested, and kept consistent across its entire commercial life. The work involves hundreds of regulatory commitments, post-approval changes, and cross-market submissions. Today it runs on documents, spreadsheets, and institutional memory. Cheiron augments manual workflows with a CMC regulatory-specific intelligence and reasoning layer.

Founded in 2024 by Stanford-trained AI researchers. The team includes leaders with combined decades of experience across pharma and biotech. Headquartered in Los Altos, California. We are building and deploying the product now with rapid expansion into global markets.

sections.title: ■ About the Role
paras: You solve product problems end to end. You go deep into how CMC and regulatory teams actually work and how they use our product: how a manufacturing change moves from the plant through QA and regulatory affairs to a filing in each market, who decides what, and where today’s tools fail them. You keep going until you understand the problem better than the brief that named it, then turn it into real user workflows, engineering-ready specs, and data models, settled on paper before a line of code is written.

CMC is a specialized world with its own regulatory frameworks and its own workflows. You do not need to know it coming in. You’ll learn it first-hand, from the regulations and guidance themselves, from customers’ own trackers and filings, and from the people who do the work, with a life sciences team alongside you who own the regulatory rules and check your reasoning. What matters is that you’re the kind of person who immerses until you can reason from first principles.

This is a ground-floor role at an early-stage company. You’ll work directly with the founders and the product/design, life sciences, and engineering teams. The learning curve is steep, the scope is real, and your specs go directly to pharma teams making real regulatory decisions.

sections.title: ■ What You'll Do
bullets: Go deep on how our users work: talk to customers, read the trackers, SOPs, and filings they work from, and map each workflow step by step across regulatory affairs, QA, and manufacturing before deciding what to build
Know what customers’ existing systems, such as RIM and QMS, already cover and where they stop, and decide what Cheiron adds on top, including when the honest answer is nothing

Turn what you learn into real user workflows (who does each step, what they need to see, what they decide), then break them into components, define relationships and boundaries with the product team and SMEs, and scope what goes into the build
Write numbered feature stories with acceptance criteria, edge cases, and state transitions that an engineer can pick up cold
Design data models and API contracts against the existing schema; identify what to extend, what to refactor, and what to leave alone
Prototype the workflows you spec, so customers and engineers react to working screens rather than a document
Run specs through review with engineering and the life sciences team before handoff; resolve ambiguity during build rather than letting it travel
Connect proactively with the life sciences team for domain input and approval on regulatory content; know when to engage them and when to move independently

sections.title: ■ What We're Looking For
bullets: 0–3 years of experience in product management, technical program management, software engineering, or a related technical role (internships count)
You have found the real problem yourself: you went to the users, learned how the work actually gets done, and changed what got built because of it. Internship, research, and project work count

Strong technical foundation: you can read a codebase, reason about system architecture, and ground a spec in what already exists. CS, engineering, or equivalent technical degree from a top-tier institution
You have written structured technical documents: specs, design docs, architecture proposals, or research papers with clear requirements and edge cases. Academic and internship work counts
You have built something in an environment with real constraints: a startup internship, a research lab, a side project with users, or an entrepreneurial venture
Fluent with AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent, and you use them to go deeper, not to skip the thinking
Clear, precise writing. A stranger reading your spec can implement it without asking you questions
When you encounter an unfamiliar domain or system, your instinct is to build a mental model of how it works before deciding what to change

sections.title: The Role:

Design, develop, deploy and manage customer-specific proof of value (PoV) projects.

sections.title: About Formance
paras: Formance builds open-source financial infrastructure. Our core product is a programmable double-entry ledger. Fintechs, crypto platforms, and financial institutions use it as the source of truth for their balances: every movement of money is recorded as a transaction between accounts, and every balance can be traced back to the postings that produced it.
Around the ledger, we connect to banks and payment providers and reconcile what the ledger records against what actually moved.
We are a team of 30+ people, mostly engineers, working across New York and Paris. Our systems support real money movement, so correctness is not optional.

sections.title: What you will work on
paras: Our customers are engineering teams building financial products. They come to us with questions like “how do we track user wallets, pending funds, and fees so that every cent is accounted for?” or “what happens to our balances when a payment fails halfway through?”
You help them answer those questions, from the first technical conversation through proof of concept and into a successful transition to implementation.
You will join a small Solutions Engineering team and work closely with our founders, NYC sales team, and engineers.
bullets: Design money flows. Turn a customer's product into a ledger model: which accounts exist, how funds move between them, and how balances are queried. Typical use cases include user wallets, pending vs. settled funds, fees and revenue sharing, refunds and chargebacks, and multi-currency.

Build trust with technical buyers. Challenge assumptions, answer complex engineering questions, and help prospective customers evaluate how Formance fits into their existing infrastructure. You are comfortable engaging directly with senior technical decision-makers.

Support the transition to production. Work with our implementation team to ensure a smooth handover, sharing technical context, architectural decisions, and customer requirements. Stay involved when your expertise is needed to resolve complex technical questions.
Bring the field back to the product. Turn recurring customer patterns into reference models, examples, and documentation, and share structured feedback with our engineering team in Paris.
Support customers beyond the initial sale , helping with technical onboarding, implementation, and a smooth transition to ongoing customer support.

Familiarity with real payment flows, including settlement delays, returns, partial failures, and mismatches between internal records and external providers.
Hands-on technical experience with APIs, databases, and at least one programming language.

An independent approach to problem-solving. You learn unfamiliar systems quickly and use modern development tools, including AI, where they improve your work.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We are looking for a Senior Principal Product Manager to lead Gen Digital’s Digital Footprint Control capability. This role will help consumers reduce unwanted personal data exposure, limit behavioral tracking, and maintain ongoing visibility and control over their digital presence.

This is a high-impact, consumer-first product leadership role for someone who understands that privacy is a fundamental expectation, not simply a product feature. You will translate that principle into protection capabilities that are simple, trustworthy, effective, and valuable to consumers at scale.

You will own the strategy across capabilities that help consumers reduce, remove, and control their digital footprint, including personal data removal, tracking protection, and account and identity exposure management. You will also define how these capabilities evolve across efficacy, international markets, partner ecosystems, mobile experiences, and AI-driven automation.

sections.title: Current Product Portfolio

Reputation Defender: Online reputation management and personal information removal from people-search sites and the broader web.
Avast One Breach Guard and Privacy Control: Data breach monitoring and in-product privacy controls within the Avast One suite.
Anti-Track: Behavioral tracking protection across web browsers and mobile, blocking data-collection mechanisms that contribute to the data broker ecosystem.
Online Account Cleaner: Identification and remediation of dormant online accounts that create ongoing personal data exposure risks.

sections.title: Efficacy and Consumer Outcomes
paras: Protection that does not demonstrably work is not protection. You will define what effectiveness means across every capability area and maintain a high quality bar.
bullets: Define and own quality dimensions such as removal success rates, re-listing detection, tracking-block coverage, and account-closure completion.
Build consumer-facing efficacy signals that make protection visible, measurable, and trustworthy.
Continuously improve capability depth so Gen’s products deliver meaningfully more value than manual alternatives or competing solutions.
Translate efficacy data into roadmap priorities and engineering investment decisions.

sections.title: The Role
paras: AI is changing what it means to run enterprise pre-sales. Building a custom demo, standing up a proof-of-concept environment, or drafting responses to a security questionnaire used to mean days of manual configuration and copy-paste from old RFP answers. Increasingly, that first-draft work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI can generate demo environments, draft PoC configurations, and produce a first pass on technical RFP responses.

The job shifts with it. Instead of building every demo and proof point from scratch, you specify exactly what a prospect needs to see, direct AI to build the first draft, and apply the judgment AI can't: does this PoC actually prove the thing this customer's IT security team will ask about, does this demo reflect how their approval hierarchy actually works, is this RFP answer technically accurate or just plausible-sounding.

As Omnea's AI Sales Engineer, you're the technical authority in our enterprise sales process, working alongside Sales to win some of the world's largest companies. You run discovery, build and direct demos and PoCs, and become the trusted technical advisor a prospect leans on to decide whether Omnea is real. You're deep in the modern finance and procurement stack - ERPs, CLMs, GRC, AP automation - and you use that expertise to judge what AI produces, not just to present it.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own technical discovery and demos: Run technical discovery sessions with prospects, direct AI to build a first-draft demo environment tailored to what you've learned, then adapt it based on what only a human would catch - a workflow quirk, a compliance requirement, a stakeholder's pet objection.

Drive PoCs end to end: Scope and own proof-of-concepts in collaboration with Product and the Customer team, directing AI to configure the environment fast and applying your own judgment on whether the PoC actually proves what the prospect needs to see to move forward.

Answer the hard technical and security questions: Direct AI to draft first-pass responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires, then validate every answer against the prospect's actual requirements - a wrong answer here can lose the deal or create a problem after signature.

Be the bridge between Sales, Product, and Customer: Translate what you're hearing in the field into product feedback, and hand off cleanly to the Customer team so nothing gets lost between a signed contract and a live deployment.

Build the pre-sales toolkit: Keep demo environments, technical documentation, and RFP libraries sharp, using AI to draft and refresh materials as the product evolves, and refining what works based on what's actually landing with prospects.

sections.title: Overview
paras: Mesh is seeking a Founding PM for Agentic Commerce.

AI agents will change how commerce and payments work. Every payment flow today assumes a human is present ... someone to look at the price and click confirm. Agents break that assumption, and no one knows what replaces it. Mesh needs to be at the front lines finding out.

This role is unlike any other PM role at Mesh. There is no product to ship yet. Your job is to figure out how agents will buy, sell, and move money. You will build with the emerging protocols, embed in the community, and run experiments on live payment rails, working directly with our SVP of Product to turn what you learn into where Mesh bets.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Be the center of gravity for agentic commerce at Mesh. Every question about agents and money movement routes to you ... what's real, what's hype, what we test, what we ignore. If an agent touches a payment, you have a view on it.

Be the expert the company doesn't have yet. The protocols, the standards bodies, the model capabilities, the startups, the failures. When a customer asks "what is Mesh's agent story?", you are where the answer comes from ... and today, no one at Mesh can answer it.

Build the proof, hands-on. Working agents completing real transactions on live rails ... not decks, not memos. You write the code, wire up the protocols, and run the experiments. When an experiment needs a customer, you recruit them from our existing base.

Represent Mesh at the frontier. Protocol working groups, hackathons, the rooms where standards get set. Mesh should be a name in agentic commerce before it has a product there ... you are how that happens.

Make the case for what Mesh builds first. When a hypothesis survives, the work changes: write the case, size the bet, and defend it with the SVP of Product. The strength of your evidence determines the speed of the company.

sections.title: The Opportunity:
paras:

We are seeking a Product Manager to bridge our core Infrastructure & AI Native Business Systems efforts with company-wide operational execution.

This is not a siloed RevOps or traditional Business Intelligence role. Your mandate is company-wide. Partnering across our infrastructure and platform teams, you will expand Ohalo’s core operational capabilities with AI including harnessing agent frameworks, MCP tooling, maintaining skills, etc and ensure best practices are accessible across every department. You will turn foundational AI capabilities into pragmatic, high-impact operational systems, ensuring the whole company runs on a trusted, unified digital layer rather than a patchwork of vibe coded applications. This is a role for a hands-on operator who understands systems and can prototype solutions directly to prove value before hardening into new platform capabilities.

sections.title: Responsibilities:
bullets: Scale Company-Wide AI Deployment: Partner across engineering teams to extend core AI capabilities across the entire business. Drive company-wide adoption of agent infrastructure.

Manage MCP & Tooling Access: Define and govern Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and agent skills. Ensure native agents (spanning leadership team to commercial ops and backoffice G&A) have secure, reliable access to internal tools and systems of record.

Improve Evals & Quality Standards: Stand up evaluation frameworks for operations and establish consistent feedback loops. Monitor AI agent performance, latency, accuracy, and cost-to-serve, continuously refining skills and prompts to ensure high-fidelity outputs.

Architect Enterprise Reporting & Ground Truth: Serve as the company’s absolute metric authority. Define, standardize, and govern KPIs across Commercial, Ops, People, and G&A so leadership makes decisions based on a single source of truth calculated at the system level.

Automate Operational Friction: Identify repetitive manual reporting and execution workflows company-wide. Deploy AI-native automations and measure real ROI, operational efficiency gains, and time saved.
Own Technical Delivery & Prototyping: Maintain an extreme ownership mindset. Personally prototype v1 workflows and reporting to validate proof-of-concepts before scaling across platform engineering.

Prevent Tool & System Sprawl: Enforce strong platform governance so new agent tools and dashboards plug seamlessly into Ohalo’s core architecture rather than spawning fragmented UI layers or data silos.

sections.title: Requirements / Candidate Profile:
bullets: Technical & Analytical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative field preferred. Highly fluent in SQL/Python and comfortable interfacing with modern API/data architecture.
Proven Track Record: 5+ years of product management experience building internal platforms, business systems, or operational tooling with company-wide scope.

AI Infrastructure & Agent Literacy: Deep understanding of modern AI technology concepts including LLM evaluation frameworks (evals), model context protocols (MCPs), and agent orchestration/harnessing.

Hands-On Builder Spirit: Actively uses AI tooling, agentic coding harnesses, or vibe coding platforms in daily prototyping and workflow design. You don't just write specs; you build scrappy prototypes.
Systems Unification Experience: Demonstrated history of taking manual, Excel-based, or multi-department fragmented processes and turning them into scalable automated systems.

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: A new ecosystem at the intersection of wellness and technology, with a connected product, hardware and software, built to help people take an active role in their own health rather than simply measure it. The Ecommerce Product Manager owns the site where people decide to become members.

Your job is to build the path to purchase. You'll own it on Shopify, from landing pages through product pages, checkout, and membership signup, along with the roadmap, testing, and web partners behind it. You'll carry the brand vision and positioning onto every page, and build a site that educates, captures leads, and earns search visibility as well as one that sells. You'll decide what the site needs to do, specify it clearly, get it built, and keep improving conversion once it's live. We are pre-launch, and the brand, the positioning, and the claims we can make are all still being built. You'll start from a business case and a blank store rather than a site with history. It's a hands-on role.

sections.title: Path to Purchase
bullets: Own the Site Roadmap : Set the roadmap for the path to purchase on Shopify: landing pages, product pages, checkout, and membership signup. Decide what gets built, in what order, and why.

Carry the Brand and Positioning : Execute the brand vision and the positioning from Brand and Product Marketing across the site, so every page looks, sounds, and explains the product the way the brand intends.
Build Dynamic Landing Pages : Stand up landing pages that match the ad, creator, or campaign that sent someone there, and that can be built and changed quickly.
Support Education, Lead Capture, and Search : Build the pages and capture points that educate visitors, grow the waitlist and lead list, and support SEO and AEO with the shared search resource.

sections.title: Conversion & Testing
bullets: Own Conversion : Set and report conversion rate, average order value, and checkout and signup completion, find where people drop out of the funnel, and report weekly and monthly against targets.
Test and Learn : Run a structured CRO and A/B testing program, read results honestly, document what you learn, and use it to decide what gets built next.

Execute Offers and Campaigns : Build and launch offers, bundles, promotions, and campaign pages, and make sure the site is ready for every launch. Offer and pricing decisions come from leadership; you make them work on the page.

smartrecruiters:versant3:744000144453089.summary:
VERSANT is an independent, publicly traded company that brings together powerhouse brands such as CNBC, MS NOW (formerly MSNBC), USA Network, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Golf Channel, along with dynamic digital and direct-to-consumer brands such as Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow, and GolfPass.

StockStory, part of CNBC and VERSANT, is building the next generation of AI-powered equity research for individual investors. We operate like a startup—a small team with high ownership, fast decisions, and direct access to leadership—while benefiting from the resources and long-term commitment of a well-capitalized public company.

sections.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform – Equity Research
paras: Our mission is simple: help millions of individual investors make better investment decisions. We’re combining AI, institutional-quality investment research, proprietary data, and exceptional engineering to redefine how retail investors discover, research, and evaluate stocks.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with deep experience building consumer investing, financial research, or market-data products to help us build a new generation of AI-powered equity research products.

This role sits at the intersection of consumer fintech, public equities, financial data, and AI. You will work with a high-caliber team that brings together top-tier engineering and buy-side investing talent, including analysts with prior experience at firms such as Millennium, Point72, and KKR.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Own and evolve core stock research and discovery experiences across StockStory’s AI-powered investing platform.
Develop a deep understanding of our users through regular interviews, usability testing, behavioral analysis, and other forms of product discovery.
Study how individual investors discover ideas, research companies, evaluate financial performance and valuation, compare stocks, build conviction, monitor investments, and make buy/sell decisions.
Translate customer problems, investing workflows, competitive insights, and behavioral data into clear product opportunities, requirements, roadmaps, and execution plans.
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Equity Research to build products that combine AI, financial data, and expert investment research into simple and compelling consumer experiences.
Play an integral role in defining our AI product experience, including how AI-generated research and recommendations communicate reasoning, evidence, sources, assumptions, uncertainty, and risk.

Help establish product standards for trust and quality in AI-generated financial research, working with our investment and technical teams to determine how outputs are evaluated before and after launch.

Build and improve products such as AI research reports, stock discovery and screening tools, company research experiences, investment recommendations, watchlists, portfolio insights, and conversational research interfaces.

sections.title: What We’re Looking For
bullets: Minimum of 5 years of product management experience, including meaningful experience building B2C consumer-facing products serving retail or individual customers.

Demonstrated experience owning products used by self-directed retail investors, ideally across one or more of the following areas: stock discovery, screeners, equity research, market data, company/fundamental data, watchlists, portfolio analytics, investment recommendations, financial news, or AI-powered investing tools.

Strong public-equities fluency. You should understand financial statements, earnings, valuation multiples, consensus estimates, catalysts, investment theses, and the basic process investors use to evaluate public companies.

Proven ability to take consumer product features from discovery through launch and iteration, including customer interviews, problem definition, PRDs/product requirements, prioritization, engineering execution, launch planning, experimentation, and post-launch measurement.

Experience building high-engagement consumer or subscription products, with a strong understanding of activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and the behaviors that drive recurring product usage.
Strong quantitative product instincts and experience using behavioral data, funnels, cohort analysis, experimentation, and product metrics to make decisions and evaluate launches.
Experience working with data-intensive products and translating complex information into consumer experiences that are intuitive, useful, and trustworthy.

Experience building AI-powered consumer products or features is strongly preferred. You should understand the opportunities and product challenges associated with LLM-generated content, including accuracy, explainability, source attribution, user trust, latency, and evaluation.
